name: PrintLoom – Product Designer for WooCommerce
author: jovaniedesquitado

sections.description:
PrintLoom turns any WooCommerce store into a print shop. Sell custom t-shirts, hoodies, mugs, caps, tote bags, stickers and more: customers design the product themselves, and you receive print-ready files with every order. No monthly fees, no per-order fees, and everything runs on your own site.

Try the live demo, or click Preview above to test PrintLoom in your browser without installing anything.

Add a Customize button to any simple or variable WooCommerce product. Shoppers open a full-screen Design Studio, add text, photos, SVG artwork and shapes on a live preview of your product, and add the design to the cart. You get print-ready files with every order.

For your customers

  • Text in four standard fonts, any color and size
  • Upload photos (PNG, JPG, WebP) and SVG artwork, or paste an image with Ctrl+V
  • Crop photos and apply filters: black & white, sepia, vintage, warm, cool, brightness and contrast
  • Ready-made shapes they can recolor
  • Freehand drawing with a brush
  • QR codes made right in the browser (links, menus, social profiles)
  • Your own studio accent color, to match your brand
  • My designs: logged-in customers save designs to their account and reopen them from the studio or My account
  • Layer tools: lock, hide, drag to reorder, flip, align and snap to center
  • Bold, italic, underline and text alignment
  • 12 photo filters
  • Realistic look: the folds and shadows of your product photo show through the design (print files stay clean)
  • Optional free photo search (public domain and CC0 images from Wikimedia Commons)
  • Drag, resize, rotate, layers, undo and redo
  • Zoom in for detail and preview the finished product
  • Colors, sizes and prices come straight from your variations, with the right mockup photo for each color
  • See the real size of every element, with a warning when a photo may print blurry
  • Leave a note for your print shop
  • Order a design again: one click on a past order reopens the design in the studio, ready to change and order
  • Drafts are saved in the browser

For your shop

  • 1-minute setup: choose what your customers will design (t-shirts, hoodies, tote bags, mugs, caps, posters) and PrintLoom creates a ready-to-try product with a mockup photo, print area, print size and price
  • Production board: every order with a design moves from Artwork check to Approved, Printing and Done (drag and drop), with a Production column in WooCommerce → Orders
  • Quick setup: pick a product and a type (t-shirt, hoodie, tote bag, mug, cap…) and the print area and print size are set for you
  • Turn the designer on per product and drag the print area into place on your product photo
  • Copy designer settings from one product to many in one click
  • Set the real print size (inches or centimeters); the box keeps the right proportions
  • High-resolution PNG artwork for DTF/DTG, made at your print resolution (300 DPI by default)
  • Private downloads from the order screen: preview, artwork and the editable design
  • Designs are saved with the cart item and the order; unfinished designs are cleaned up after seven days
  • Customize button on product pages automatically, or place it with the Elementor widget, the block or the [aiph_designer] shortcode
  • Works with HPOS (custom order tables)

Who is it for?

  • Print shops (DTF, DTG, screen printing, sublimation, embroidery) that want customers to design online
  • Stores selling personalized gifts: mugs, tumblers, phone cases, tote bags, caps
  • Teams, schools and clubs ordering custom apparel
  • Agencies building WooCommerce stores for print businesses

PrintLoom Pro

A separate, paid add-on (PrintLoom Pro) is available from aipluginhub.io. It adds back and sleeve printing, team names & numbers, several sizes in one order, print pricing by ink colors and quantity, color swatches, 3D preview for mugs and bottles, design templates, AI design generation, background removal, a graphics library, print PDFs, ZIP downloads, production sheets, design proofs and vector SVG files. Everything in this plugin works without it, and nothing in it is locked or time-limited.

External services

PrintLoom works without any external service. One optional feature connects to a third-party service:

  • Free photo search (off by default). When a shop manager turns on Settings → Storefront → Free photo search, the Design Studio shows a search box under Upload. When a customer searches or picks an image, the customer’s browser sends the search words to the Wikimedia Commons API (commons.wikimedia.org) and loads the chosen image from Wikimedia’s servers (upload.wikimedia.org). No account, key or personal data is sent by the plugin; Wikimedia receives the request like any website visit (IP address and browser details). Only public domain and CC0 images are requested. Wikimedia Foundation Terms of Use and Privacy Policy.

Third-party libraries

  • Fabric.js 5.3.0 — MIT License (see assets/vendor/FABRIC-LICENSE). Bundled unmodified.
  • QR Code Generator 2.0.4 by Kazuhiko Arase — MIT License (see assets/vendor/QRCODE-LICENSE). Bundled unmodified.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. Install and activate this plugin from Plugins → Add New.
  3. Edit a product and open the PrintLoom tab in Product data. Turn on Let customers design this product, drag the print area over your product photo and, if you like, enter the real print size.
  4. Visit the product page and click Customize this product.

Settings are in WooCommerce → Design Studio.
sections.faq:
Which products work?

Simple and variable products. Give each color variation its own image and the studio shows the right mockup.

Where do I find the print files?

Open the order in WooCommerce → Orders. Each designed item shows a preview with links to the artwork PNG and the editable design.

How large are the print files?

When a product has a real print size, artwork is made at your print resolution (Settings → Print files, 300 DPI by default), up to 6000 pixels per side. Without a print size, the artwork export width set on the product is used.

Is the plugin really free?

Yes. Everything described above is included, with no limits on products, designs or orders, and no fees on your sales. Pro is an optional add-on.

Does it work with my theme and page builder?

Yes. The Design Studio opens as its own full-screen page, so your theme doesn’t affect it. The Customize button appears on product pages automatically, or you can place it with the Elementor widget, the block or the [aiph_designer] shortcode.

Does it work on phones and tablets?

Yes. On phones and tablets the studio uses a full-screen product view with a bottom tool bar and panels that slide up.

Does the plugin connect to any outside service?

Not unless you turn on the optional free photo search (see External services below). Everything else runs on your site and in the customer’s browser. Uploaded images and finished designs stay on your server in a private folder.

Can customers download each other’s designs?

No. Artwork files are stored with a PHP guard and are only delivered to shop managers from the order screen. Customers can only see the previews of their own designs in their cart.
sections.changelog:
1.5.5

  • New: 1-minute setup. Pick what your customers will design and PrintLoom creates a draft product with a mockup photo, print area, print size, price and optional sizes.
  • New: Production board (WooCommerce → Design Studio → Production). Move orders with designs from Artwork check to Approved, Printing and Done; each move adds a private order note.
  • New: Production column in WooCommerce → Orders.
  • New: “Order this design again” on the customer’s order page reopens the ordered design in the studio.
  • Shop managers can now try the studio on draft products before publishing them.

1.5.4

  • New: after your store receives a few orders with customer designs, the Design Studio screens show a small, dismissible note asking for a WordPress.org review. “Maybe later” hides it for 30 days and “Don’t show again” hides it for good.

1.5.3

  • Security hardening: design data, product options and settings are sanitized value by value when received; the product screen checks its nonce and permissions itself.

1.5.2

  • Admin: product photos in the Products list, Settings and Design Studio links on the Plugins screen, the side menu wraps on narrow screens, wider price fields.

1.5.1

  • Fix: after Undo, Redo, applying a template or opening a saved design, the Front/Back side buttons could stay disabled.
  • Fix: a locked element could not be unlocked with the lock button.
  • New: arrow keys move the selected element (Shift for 10 px); Ctrl/⌘+D duplicates, Ctrl/⌘+Y redoes.
  • Phones: every tool tab fits the bottom bar; messages no longer cover the product while a panel is open; long messages wrap.
  • Tablets and smaller desktops: header actions switch to icons (with tooltips) so nothing wraps or overflows.

1.5.0

  • New admin layout: a Design Studio app with a side menu, a Dashboard (products, designs, orders with designs, a setup checklist and shortcuts) and clearer page headers.
  • Product screen: the PrintLoom tab shows one section at a time with section tabs (a dot marks features that are on), or all at once.

1.4.0

  • New: realistic look. The folds and shadows of the product photo show through the customer’s design on screen and in the cart preview. Print files are made without it. Settings → Storefront → Realistic look (Off, Subtle, Strong).
  • New hooks for add-ons: forceLock, canDelete and noSelect (template rules), sideArea in the studio API.

1.3.0

  • New: optional free photo search. Customers search public domain and CC0 photos and illustrations from Wikimedia Commons right in the studio (turn it on in Settings → Storefront).

1.2.0

  • New: My designs. Logged-in customers save designs to their account, open them again from the studio, and manage them in WooCommerce → My account → My designs. Saved designs are deleted with the customer’s account.
  • New: lock and hide elements, drag layers to reorder, send backward, flip, and align to the print area. Elements snap to the center while dragging.
  • New: bold, italic, underline and left/center/right text alignment.
  • New photo filters: Vivid, Fade, Noir, Film, Polaroid and Invert.
  • Hidden elements are not printed and don’t count toward print pricing.

1.1.0

  • New look for the Design Studio: tool rail, clean panel and dotted work area on desktop; full-screen canvas with a bottom tab bar and bottom sheet on tablets and phones.
  • New: studio accent color (Settings → Storefront) so the studio matches your brand.
  • New: Elements tab with 12 shapes, freehand drawing and a QR code maker.
  • Quick start card on an empty design on every screen size.

1.0.4

  • Styles are loaded through the WordPress style system only (no inline style tags).
  • A few more strings can be translated.

1.0.3

  • Phone and tablet: the “Add text to design” button now sits right under the text box.

1.0.2

  • New: phone and tablet layout for the Design Studio: full-screen product, a tab bar at the bottom and tools that slide up in a panel.
  • New: quick start buttons on an empty design (upload an image, add text, browse designs).
  • New: bigger handles on touch screens; undo, redo and zoom float over the product.
  • Fix: the price range no longer shows twice while the studio loads.
  • Fix: the size of a newly added shape could show as “NaN”.

1.0.1

  • New: the product settings have their own PrintLoom tab in Product data, with an on/off switch, a short checklist and an “Open studio” button.
  • New: one card per print side with the drag box, print size and exact position; exact percentages are tucked away under “Exact position”.
  • New: help tooltips on product and settings fields.
  • New: redesigned Design Studio screen and settings cards.
  • Developers: aiph_product_panel and aiph_product_side_fields hooks, plus aiph_field(), aiph_switch() and aiph_card_open() helpers for add-ons.

1.0.0

  • New: crop photos and apply filters (black & white, sepia, vintage, warm, cool, brightness, contrast).
  • New: quick setup with ready-made print areas for t-shirts, hoodies, tote bags, mugs, caps and posters.
  • New: copy designer settings from one product to others.
  • Developers: async exportSide hook, filterable file kinds and price total.

0.9.0

  • The free plugin now contains the complete core designer; Pro features moved to a separate add-on.
  • New: real print size per product, print resolution setting and size/DPI readout in the studio.
  • New: paste images or text with Ctrl+V, zoom, and notes for the print shop.
